description: OpenAgentPlatform-specific anti-pattern rules (OAP-* namespace), plus retuned overrides of DevGate baseline PREVENT-* rules. The overlay merges onto the baseline by rule_id: an entry here REPLACES the same-id bundled rule (so OAP retunes a false positive or narrows an over-broad pattern without editing the submodule), and new OAP-* ids append.

rules.name: SQL injection risk via string concatenation
rules.message: Potential SQL injection: String concatenation in SQL query
rules.suggestion: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements

rules.name: fmt.Println in library code
rules.message: fmt.Print* in library code — use structured logging instead
rules.suggestion: Replace with slog.Info/slog.Error or a logger interface

rules.name: console.log in source
rules.message: console.log in non-test source code
rules.suggestion: Remove or replace with a structured logger

rules.name: debugger statement
rules.message: debugger statement left in source
rules.suggestion: Remove debugger statement before committing

rules.name: eval() usage
rules.message: eval() is a security risk and performance anti-pattern
rules.suggestion: Use JSON.parse for data, or a safe alternative to eval

rules.name: Empty catch block
rules.message: Empty catch block silently swallows errors
rules.suggestion: Log the error or rethrow: catch (e) { logger.error(e); }

rules.name: os.Exit in library code
rules.message: os.Exit in library code prevents graceful shutdown and testing
rules.suggestion: Return an error to the caller instead of calling os.Exit

rules.name: Unchecked error return
rules.message: Function call result not captured — possible unchecked error
rules.suggestion: Capture and handle the error: result, err := fn(); if err != nil { ... }

rules.name: Context without timeout in HTTP handler
rules.message: Using request context without adding a timeout for downstream calls
rules.suggestion: Add timeout for downstream calls: ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 30*time.Second)

rules.name: TODO without ticket reference
rules.message: TODO without a ticket reference will be lost
rules.suggestion: Add ticket: TODO(OAP-123): description

rules.name: Any type in TypeScript
rules.message: Explicit 'any' type bypasses type safety
rules.suggestion: Use a specific type, unknown, or a generic constraint

rules.name: import from 'fs' in frontend
rules.message: Node fs module imported in frontend code
rules.suggestion: Use browser APIs or a backend endpoint instead of fs

rules.name: process.env in frontend
rules.message: process.env used in frontend — Vite uses import.meta.env
rules.suggestion: Use import.meta.env.VITE_* instead of process.env

rules.name: Goroutine without recovery
rules.message: Goroutine started without panic recovery
rules.suggestion: Add defer/recover or use a helper like errgroup for managed goroutines

rules.name: time.Sleep in tests
rules.message: time.Sleep in tests creates flaky, slow tests
rules.suggestion: Use eventually/polling, channels, or test doubles instead of sleep

rules.name: Hardcoded IP address
rules.message: Hardcoded IP address — use configuration instead
rules.suggestion: Move to config/env: os.Getenv("SERVER_HOST")

rules.name: http.Server without ReadHeaderTimeout
rules.message: http.Server constructed without ReadHeaderTimeout (slowloris exposure)
rules.suggestion: Set ReadHeaderTimeout (and ReadTimeout/WriteTimeout/IdleTimeout as appropriate)

rules.name: SQL string concatenation in Go
rules.message: SQL query built via string concatenation — injection risk
rules.suggestion: Use db.Query(sql, args...) or sqlx with named parameters

rules.name: Deprecated ioutil usage
rules.message: io/ioutil is deprecated since Go 1.16
rules.suggestion: Use os.ReadFile, os.WriteFile, io.ReadAll, os.ReadDir, os.MkdirTemp, os.CreateTemp, io.NopCloser, io.Discard

rules.name: PyYAML unsafe_load
rules.message: yaml.load without SafeLoader is a code execution risk
rules.suggestion: Use yaml.safe_load() or yaml.load(data, Loader=yaml.SafeLoader)

rules.name: subprocess shell=True
rules.message: subprocess with shell=True is a command injection risk
rules.suggestion: Use subprocess.run([cmd, arg1, arg2]) with a list instead of shell=True

rules.name: AWS access key ID
rules.message: AWS access key ID detected in source
rules.suggestion: Revoke the key, then load credentials from IAM roles or environment variables. Ported from the in-repo Go gate's secret-scan rule set.

rules.name: GitHub token
rules.message: GitHub token detected in source
rules.suggestion: Revoke the token and use a secret manager or GitHub Actions secrets. Ported from the in-repo Go gate's secret-scan rule set.

rules.name: Private key material
rules.message: Private key material embedded in source
rules.suggestion: Remove the key from the tree and rotate it; history rewrite is required since the key is already committed. Ported from the in-repo Go gate's secret-scan rule set.

rules.name: Assigned secret literal
rules.message: Hardcoded credential literal assigned in source
rules.suggestion: Use environment variables or a secret manager. Ported from the in-repo Go gate's secret-scan rule set.

rules.name: GCP service account key
rules.message: GCP service account key JSON embedded in source
rules.suggestion: Use workload identity federation instead of a downloaded service-account key. Ported from the in-repo Go gate's secret-scan rule set.

rules.name: Azure storage account key
rules.message: Azure storage account key detected in source
rules.suggestion: Rotate the key and use managed identities or a Key Vault reference. Ported from the in-repo Go gate's secret-scan rule set.

rules.name: npm access token
rules.message: npm access token detected in source
rules.suggestion: Revoke the token and use an .npmrc populated from CI secrets. Ported from the in-repo Go gate's secret-scan rule set.

rules.name: Stripe secret key
rules.message: Stripe secret API key detected in source
rules.suggestion: Roll the key in the Stripe dashboard and inject it from a secret manager. Ported from the in-repo Go gate's secret-scan rule set.

rules.name: Hardcoded credentials
rules.message: Possible hardcoded credential detected
rules.suggestion: Use environment variables or a secret manager. Baseline pattern matched any token" string (including split/join calls); this override requires the literal to carry the value (assign/colon) and be >=8 chars.

rules.name: Go: Ignored error return (value+error discards)
rules.message: Error return value ignored. Always check errors in Go.
rules.suggestion: Bind the error and handle it: v, err := f(); if err != nil { ... }, or annotate a deliberate discard inline: // guardrails-allow PREVENT-009: <reason>
